register_op: register a new vLLM IR op with a native implementation function and optional custom name
register_impl: register a provider-specific implementation for an IrOp with platform support and argument checks
set_priority: set dispatch priority for IrOp implementations using a context manager to temporarily reorder providers
enable_torch_wrap: enable or disable torch custom op wrapping for vLLM IR ops to bypass dispatch overhead
dispatch: dispatch an IrOp call to the appropriate implementation based on priority and argument support checks
